title: Check-in: from doing to managing
caption: Two quick questions, then two to close.

poll.qrLabel: QR code to the directpoll vote page
poll.resultsHint: Loads from directpoll.com only after the click.

seen.question: Has AI ever created more work than it saved you, e.g. checking and reworking?

known.question: Did you know: with AI you become more manager than maker?

answers.practice: yes, and I work this way

modelAfter.question: And now: what is AI most like for you?

answers.search: Search engine – just smarter, gives answers
answers.chat: Chat – a conversation partner for my questions
answers.assistant: Assistant – works along inside my tools
answers.colleague: Colleague – I let it take over whole tasks
answers.factory: Factory – an AI organisation running for me

shift.question: Has your picture of AI changed today?

talking-points.header: Stop the recording, then check in
talking-points.description: Stop the recording, then step the directpoll cockpit to the ai-gives-you-more-work questions. Let people answer first, then show the results; the counts go anonymously into the analysis (AIE-0016). Last, the question from the start once more: has your picture of AI shifted?
